fields.name: revealEnabled
fields.tooltip: Master switch. Off, the whole track stands assembled, as before.

fields.name: startAhead
fields.tooltip: Metres ahead of the reference where a piece STARTS rising. The runner's fog ends at ~480 m: keep this inside it.

fields.name: band
fields.tooltip: Metres a piece takes to seat once the front passes it. Seated at Start Ahead − Band (+ its stagger).

fields.name: stagger
fields.tooltip: Random extra delay per piece, metres: pieces land one by one instead of as a wall.

fields.name: creepSpeed
fields.tooltip: While the reference is slower than this, the front creeps ahead on its own until the visible road is seated (Start Ahead + Band) — so nothing hangs mid-air at a standstill or on the start line.

fields.name: drop
fields.tooltip: How far below its rest a piece starts, metres along its own up.

fields.name: tiltDegrees
fields.tooltip: How far a piece starts tipped about its own X axis, degrees (the side is random per piece).

fields.name: startScale
fields.tooltip: Scale a piece starts at (1 = full size all the way).

fields.name: overshoot
fields.tooltip: Overshoot of the landing: 0 = a plain ease out, higher = the piece rises past its rest and settles back.
